title: Research: the W3C traceparent format and the OpenTelemetry Python SDK's trace-context propagator are kb facts
goal: kb/public/logs/otel-python-sdk.md gains DOC facts with source rows from the W3C Trace Context Recommendation on the traceparent header (version 00, a 32-hex trace-id, a 16-hex parent-id, the trace-flags byte with the sampled bit, the all-zero ids that are invalid, plus tracestate), and CODE facts at a pinned commit on how the Python SDK TraceContextTextMapPropagator reads and writes it from a carrier such as an environment dict, so a tool can hand a child process the context of a span it built with explicit ids

run:
import subprocess, sys
ART = 'kb/public/logs/otel-python-sdk.md'
CASES = [
    ('What is the format of the W3C traceparent header: version, trace-id, parent-id and trace-flags?', 'DOC', ['traceparent', 'trace-id', 'parent-id']),
    ('Which trace-flags bit marks a W3C traceparent as sampled?', 'DOC', ['sampled', 'trace-flags']),
    ('Which trace-id and parent-id values in a W3C traceparent are invalid?', 'DOC', ['traceparent', 'invalid']),
    ('What is the W3C tracestate header for?', 'DOC', ['tracestate']),
    ('How does the Python SDK TraceContextTextMapPropagator inject and extract a traceparent from a carrier dict?', 'CODE', ['TraceContextTextMapPropagator', 'traceparent']),
]
miss = []
for q, tag, terms in CASES:
    out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/rag.py', 'pack', q, '--root', 'public', '--budget', '2500'],
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    hit = [l for l in out.splitlines() if l.startswith('- ' + ART[len('kb/'):] + ':') and '[' + tag in l
           and all(t.lower() in l.lower() for t in terms)]
    if not hit:
        miss.append((q, terms))
print('missing:', miss if miss else 'none')
sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)
